svg.title: The Zigzag Café
svg.desc: Three work areas connect at alternating ends: bottom passage first, top passage second. Throws cut across both low rails. All C-numbered counters are interchangeable. Low rails block walking and placement but ingredients can be thrown over them.
svg.text: 13 free counters · one serving-dish type · all stations reachable on foot
C1, C2… are ordinary counters: ingredients, clean dishes, assembly or finished food.
Hatched rail = no walking or placement. Purple arrows show ingredients passing over it.
Dark counter edges = reachable working sides. Arrows are examples, not fixed recipes for a station.
Customers are beyond the kitchen: serving and dish return happen at the labeled endpoints.
Concept floor plan. Test collision, reach, throw clearance, camera and pacing in the blockout.
